scientific_limitations_and_integrity.integrity: Analytic asymptotic proof; numerical experiments are not used as proof. The full text of the motivating 2021 source was not accessible, so novelty is best-knowledge only.
limitations: No alpha=1/2 result; the input kernel is not square-integrable there.
No uniform limit as alpha approaches 1/2 or the modal rates coalesce.
No infinite-dimensional PDE, state constraints, or multi-input generalization.
scientific_limitations_and_integrity.scope: Fixed two-mode Caputo system, 1/2<alpha<1, distinct fixed nonnegative rates, scalar L2 control, zero initial state.

title: A sharp fractional small-time energy law for a two-mode control system
